faq.question: Who can attend?
faq.answer: Anyone 18 or older is welcome to participate as a hacker! You do not need prior hackathon experience, and students pursuing college or another form of higher education from any field, school, or background are encouraged to attend. Recent graduates who completed their degree within the past 12 months are also eligible. High school students are not eligible to participate. As long as you’re excited to learn, build, and have fun, we’d love to have you at Rowdy Hacks XII.

faq.question: When is the deadline to apply?
faq.answer: The deadline for registration is October 2nd, at 23:59.

faq.question: Where can I park?
faq.answer: Hackers are allowed to park at Lots D1, D2, D3. Additional paid parking is available on  Buena Vista Street.

faq.question: How much experience do I need?
faq.answer: Absolutely zero! We want you here because you have a passion for creating, not because you're the most experienced hacker on the block. We'll have lots of resources including workshops and a bunch of mentors to help beginners get started. There'll also be plenty of people to learn from and help out!

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: Nothing. Nada. Zilch. It's completely free for all accepted hackers. To make it even better, we'll be giving out a ton of swag to every hacker, and prizes to our winners.

faq.question: What should I bring?
faq.answer: Please bring a valid ID in addition to anything that would help you with creating your hack or making you comfortable. A laptop, charger, mouse, keyboard, hardware, light jacket, and any hygienic products should be helpful. Don't bring anything you wouldn't bring on an airplane.

faq.question: Can I stay overnight?
faq.answer: Yes, however, if you leave the building after its closing time, you will not be able to re-enter until it re-opens, so plan accordingly. The building closes at 6PM and re-opens at 6AM.

faq.question: Where can I park?
faq.answer: UTSA Students are allowed to Park at Lots D1, D2, D3 with a parking pass. For non-UTSA students you may park in the Dolorosa lot and there is paid parking on Buena Vista Street.

faq.question: How do teams work?
faq.answer: Teams are limited to 1-4 hackers. If you have a team in mind, make sure all members submit an application before the deadline. If you don't have a team and would like to be a part of one, no worries! We'll have a dedicated time for team formation after the opening ceremony.

faq.question: What if I have a question not addressed here?
faq.answer: Please reach out to team@rowdyhacks.org, We'll be happy to answer any questions you may have
